metadata.remarks: OSCAL v1.2.3 profile overlay tailoring the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate Baseline for Frontier AI architectures (Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4o) with defense-in-depth mitigations against MITRE ATLAS threat techniques.

set-parameters.label: Prompt Injection Filtering, Semantic Input Guardrails, and Structural Token Parsing
set-parameters.usage: Specifies input validation controls for frontier AI models against direct/indirect prompt injection (MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051) and jailbreaks (AML.T0054).
values: prompt injection filtering, semantic input guardrails, and structural token parsing

set-parameters.label: Constitutional AI Rules and Strict Tenant Context Isolation
set-parameters.usage: Specifies access enforcement controls enforcing model behavioral constraints and multi-tenant isolation.
values: constitutional AI rules and strict tenant context isolation

set-parameters.label: FIPS 140-3 Validated Encryption for Model Weights and Inference Tensors
set-parameters.usage: Specifies cryptographic mechanisms protecting model weights at rest and inference tensors across distributed accelerators.
values: FIPS 140-3 validated encryption for model weights and inference tensors

set-parameters.label: Automated Frontier Red-Teaming, CBRN Risk Evaluation, and MITRE ATLAS Matrix Coverage
set-parameters.usage: Specifies developer testing and evaluation requirements for frontier AI deployments.
values: automated frontier red-teaming, CBRN risk evaluation, and MITRE ATLAS matrix coverage

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Frontier AI deployments must enforce multi-layer semantic guardrails, prompt injection classifiers, and token-level input validation to neutralize adversarial prompt crafting prior to inference execution.

props.name: mitre-atlas-technique
props.value: AML.T0024: Exfiltration via ML Inference API

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Access enforcement must maintain strict cryptographic and memory tenant boundary isolation across context windows, KV-caches, and embedding stores, augmented by Constitutional AI policy guardrails.

props.name: mitre-atlas-technique
props.value: AML.T0005: Create Adversarial Machine Learning Artifacts

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Model weights, safetensors checkpoint shards, and distributed inference tensors across GPU interconnects (NVLink/RoCE) must utilize FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules in transit and at rest.

props.name: mitre-atlas-technique
props.value: AML.T0048: Abuse of Legitimate AI Capabilities

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Developer testing must incorporate automated frontier red-teaming frameworks covering the complete MITRE ATLAS adversarial tactics, alongside mandatory CBRN evaluation gates and autonomous cyber weaponization safeguards.
